title: POST /v1/agent/claim response
description: Body of a successful response to POST /v1/agent/claim (11-agent-access.md section 4).

bundle_ct.description: the user's identity sealed to the agent: an agent that still holds it (identity user)

user_ct.description: the user's public keys and certificate sealed to the agent: an own-identity agent (identity own, ADR-082 section 2)

identity.description: own: the agent signs with its own key as a sub-principal of its user; user: it holds its user's identity

gen.description: the generation of an own-identity agent

migrate.description: identity user and the user has a passkey: the agent converts itself (POST /v1/agent/identity, ADR-082 section 5)

migrate_gen.description: present exactly with migrate true: the generation the conversion's certificate names
